def test_specialFilter():

    assert specialFilter([33, -2, -3, 45, 21, 109]) == 2   # 33 and 109 qualify

    assert specialFilter([]) == 0

    assert specialFilter([1, 3, 5, 7, 9]) == 0

    # Boundary at 10
    assert specialFilter([10]) == 0
    assert specialFilter([11]) == 1

    # Even first digit excluded
    assert specialFilter([21, 23, 27, 29]) == 0

    # Even last digit excluded
    assert specialFilter([12, 14, 16, 18]) == 0

    # Both first and last digits odd
    assert specialFilter([13, 17, 19]) == 3

    # Multi-digit numbers
    assert specialFilter([135, 977, 246, 1002, 555]) == 3  # 135, 977, 555 qualify
    assert specialFilter([999999, 1000001, 1000000]) == 2  # 999999, 1000001 qualify

    assert specialFilter([-15, -33, -57, -11]) == 0

    # Mixed positives and negatives
    assert specialFilter([-13, 12, 31, 44]) == 1           # only 31 qualifies

    # Duplicates are counted individually
    assert specialFilter([15, 15, 15]) == 3
